feature_definition.source: The immediately preceding draw's six main numbers only; bonus is excluded.
feature_definition.gap_vector: Sort the six main numbers x1<...<x6 and compute the five internal adjacent gaps gi=x(i+1)-xi.

state_components.min_gap_bin: 0 if min(g)<=1; 1 if min(g)==2; 2 if min(g)>=3
state_components.tight_gap_count_bin: Count gaps <=2; 0 if count<=1; 1 if count==2; 2 if count>=3
state_components.wide_gap_count_bin: Count gaps >=8; 0 if count==0; 1 if count==1; 2 if count>=2
state_components.gap_spread_bin: Let spread=max(g)-min(g); 0 if spread<=4; 1 if 5<=spread<=8; 2 if spread>=9

feature_definition.distance: Hamming distance across the five frozen categorical gap-shape components.
feature_definition.transition_history: For each historical outcome round u=2..t-1, use the gap-shape state of draw u-1 as the feature and the six main numbers of draw u as the outcome. Score target t from draw t-1, then add target t only after scoring.
feature_definition.candidate_universe: All integers 1..45 are scored for every target.

estimator.conditional_count: Weighted count of each main number in historical transition outcomes.
estimator.global_rate: Count of each main number in draws 1..t-1 divided by t-1.

portfolio.geometry: Exactly three pairwise-disjoint six-number lines, union18.
portfolio.selection: Three sequential calls to the unchanged E045 choose_disjoint_ticket selector, passing the E066 score as both role_score and global_score; remove selected numbers after each line.

random_comparator.method: For each target, uniformly permute labels 1..45 jointly over the three fixed model lines, preserving three six-number lines, pairwise disjointness, union18, and line-incidence geometry.

inference.ci_method: Two-sided percentile moving-block bootstrap of per-target differences from the exact geometry-matched union18 null.
